"""核验候选后仅恢复本轮十份来源，保留归档和其他工作。"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def read(name):
    return json.loads((DATA / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

result_path = DATA / 'v60-restored-source.json'
assert not result_path.exists()
parent = read('ipm-v57-identity.json')
candidate = read('ipm-v60-identity.json')
verification = read('v60-verification.json')
assert verification['passed'] and verification['run_count'] == 136
assert verification['gate']['eligible_for_netlib'] is False
assert sha(DATA / 'ipm-v60-identity.json') == verification['identity_sha256']
assert {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in candidate['files']} == candidate['files']
assert sha(ROOT / '.tools/solver-ipm-v60.exe') == candidate['solver_sha256']
assert sha(ROOT / '.tools/solver-ipm-v57.exe') == parent['solver_sha256']
changed = sorted(name for name in parent['files'] if parent['files'][name] != candidate['files'][name])
assert changed == candidate['changed_source_files'] and len(changed) == 10
source_zip = DATA / 'ipm-v57-source.zip'
assert sha(source_zip) == parent['source_zip_sha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(source_zip) as archive:
    assert set(archive.namelist()) == set(parent['files'])
    contents = {name: archive.read(name) for name in parent['files']}
    assert {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in contents.items()} == parent['files']
    targets = {name: (ROOT / name).resolve() for name in changed}
    assert all(path.is_relative_to(ROOT) for path in targets.values())
    for name, path in targets.items():
        path.write_bytes(contents[name])
actual = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in parent['files']}
assert actual == parent['files']
result = {'passed': True, 'created_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'verification_sha256': sha(DATA / 'v60-verification.json'), 'restored_version': 'ipm-cpu-0.47.0',
    'restored_files': changed, 'source_files': len(actual), 'files': actual, 'lp_runs': 0}
with result_path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as target:
    json.dump(result, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    target.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'restored_files': len(changed), 'source_files': len(actual)}, ensure_ascii=False))
